name: Location Hotkeys
author: Anonymous
description: Bind spots in Hush House to keys and jump straight back to them.
description_long: Press Page Up to enter bind mode, then press one of the ten location keys to save the current view to it. Press that key at any other time to fly the camera back. All eleven keys are rebindable under Options > Controls. Each playthrough keeps its own set of locations, stored in location_hotkeys.json next to your save file.
